companies.Ailytics: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Airgorithm: The Hangar (NUS Enterprise)-resident Singapore startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — name is a portmanteau of 'air' + 'algorithm', suggesting aviation/airline-optimization or air-quality analytics; drop unrelated namesakes unless the article explicitly references this Hangar entity.
companies.BEEX: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore autonomous-systems startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Draper: The Hangar (NUS Enterprise)-resident Singapore event-analytics AI startup, now branded 'Draper' (previously 'Eventlytics.AI', originally 'Bardar'). The name 'Draper' is highly generic — drop unrelated hits for Draper Associates / Draper University / Draper Startup House / Draper Labs, and drop generic 'event analytics' B2B vendor news (eventbrite-tools, etc.) unless the article explicitly references Draper / its Eventlytics.AI / Bardar predecessors.
companies.Flexxon: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore cybersecurity-hardware startup (founded 2007) building X-PHY, the world's first AI-embedded SSD with hardware-level threat detection and physical-tamper response. Co-founded by Camellia Chan and May Chng. Drop items that only mention generic flash-storage or unrelated 'X-PHY' physics content.
companies.INVIGILO: NUS Enterprise-incubated Singapore deep-tech worksite-safety AI startup (founder Vishnu Saran, NUS Material Science 2015). Invigilo Safekey™ uses proprietary computer vision + language models for real-time worksite hazard detection (unsafe acts, near-misses) across construction sites, shipyards and manufacturing plants. Deployed by HDB, LTA, Hyundai E&C and others. Drop unrelated 'invigilator' / exam-proctoring tools and the unrelated 'Vigilo' brands.
companies.Microtube Technologies: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Patsnap: Singapore-headquartered IP intelligence and innovation analytics SaaS company.
companies.Qapita: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore-headquartered equity-management platform (cap-table, ESOP administration, secondary-share workflows) founded 2019 by Ravi Ravulaparthi (CEO), Lakshman Gupta (COO) and Vamsee Mohan (CTO); serves ~2,700 SEA/India companies. companies.SalesMind AI: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident sales-AI startup. Drop unrelated 'SalesMind' branded vendors (Salesmind.ai LinkedIn outreach, etc.) unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.Skuling: BLOCK71 Yogyakarta-resident Indonesian edutech startup building a gamified web learning platform — leaderboards, social discussion, performance analytics — targeting Indonesian primary/secondary education accessibility and engagement gaps. ~110,000 users across 502 of 514 Indonesian cities. Founded by Yudha Pratama Situmorang (Boston University Questrom MBA'24); 2024 Poets & Quants Most Disruptive MBA Startup. Drop generic 'schooling' / education-tech mentions.
companies.StaffAny: BLOCK71 Jakarta-listed Singapore HR-tech startup (founded by four NUS alumni) running a workforce-management app for hourly workers in F&B / retail — drag-and-drop rostering, time tracking, availability, payroll/accounting integration. ~100K+ shifts and ~700K hours tracked at the S$1M seed milestone; lead investor FreakOut Holdings; angels include ex-Zopim founders Lim Qing Ru, Kwok Yang Bin and Royston Tay plus Kenji Niwa.
companies.Taidii: BLOCK71 Suzhou-listed Singapore preschool / childcare-school-management SaaS (HQ Singapore, Suzhou ops listed twice in directory — folded here) covering attendance, billing, e-enrollment, e-forms, finance, parent-school communication; >50% private-school market share in Singapore; ECDA-approved vendor; VAMS 4S sub-second attendance / temperature device; presence in Singapore, China (Suzhou), UAE, Australia and the Philippines. Drop generic 'taid' / 'tide' branding news unless it names Taidii.
companies.Vibefam: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident community / wellness / events startup ('vibe' + 'fam'). Drop unrelated namesakes unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
